verses.1: At that time, the LORD said to me, “Make for me two stone pillars, just as before. Then go up to the mountain and build for me an altar of wood.”
verses.2: And I will write down on the tablets the words that were written on the first tablets, which you broke and placed in the fire.
verses.3: And I will build a platform of stones, and I will use two blocks of stone as a foundation. Then I will build the hill, with those two blocks of stone in my hands.
verses.4: And he wrote on the tablets, in the same manner as before, the twelve things that Jehovah spoke to you on the mountain during the day of assembly. And Jehovah gave them to me.
verses.5: And he came down from the mountain, and he placed the tablets in the ark that I had made. And they remained there as Jehovah commanded me.
verses.6: And the sons of Israel traveled from Beerot of the sons of Jacob. There, Aaron died. They buried him there. And Elazar, their priest, was placed under his leadership.
verses.7: From there, the Gadgodahs traveled. And from the Gadgodahs, the land of Nahal Mayim was freed.
verses.8: On that day, Jehovah will separate the tribe of Levi from all other tribes, so that they may carry the Ark of the Covenant of Jehovah. They will stand before Jehovah to serve him and bless his name, until this very day.
verses.9: Therefore, Levi had no share or inheritance with his brothers. It was God’s inheritance for him, as God, your God, said.
verses.10: And I stood on that mountain for forty days and forty nights. Then Jehovah heard my cry at that time. But Jehovah did not listen to your wickedness.
verses.11: And the LORD said to me, “Go and go before the people. Let them come and take possession of the land that I have promised to their ancestors.”
verses.12: And now, Israel, what will Jehovah your God ask of you? Is it that you should fear Jehovah your God and follow all His commands, and love Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.13: To keep the commandments of Jehovah and his laws, which I command you today for your good.
verses.14: To Jehovah your God, the heavens and the skies, the earth, and all that is in them.
verses.15: Only in your fathers did Jehovah show love toward them. He chose their descendants from among all nations, just as He does today.
verses.16: And they will be filled with joy in their hearts, and their sorrow will no longer be a burden for them.
verses.17: For Jehovah your God is the God of gods; He is the great and awesome God, who does not take pleasure in evil.
verses.18: He makes unjust judgments and acts with ignorance. He also loves to give his slaves bread and clothes.
verses.19: And love the stranger, for you yourselves were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.20: Fear the LORD your God; serve Him and trust in Him. And take refuge in His name.
verses.21: It is your song, and it is your God who created you in such a wonderful way. It is He who saw all these wonders that your eyes have seen.
verses.22: In seventy souls, your ancestors came down from Egypt. Now, may the LORD your God place you in a position of great glory, like the stars in the sky.
